description: Sri Lanka Customs - The Rates of Exchange effective from 22.07.2019 to 28.07.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically addressing how foreign currency transactions are to be calculated for import/export duties. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it establishes binding rates and rescinds previous notifications, representing a statutory instrument for trade compliance.
